name: FormingChapterCta - With Contact Address
description: The band a forming chapter shows where an active one shows its leads. DC has alumni and a running WhatsApp group but nobody organising events, and the old page rendered that as an empty leads heading over an empty calendar — indistinguishable from a dead chapter. These cities are online groups for now, not chapters recruiting a lead, so the band reads DC and DMV Area meets online for now and leads with Join WhatsApp to meet local alumni, with See online events as the second action — the earlier volunteer-to-lead ask was removed at review, and the lead ask now lives once in the Chapters menu. A Want to bring in-person events here? line with a Contact us link sits underneath; that button appears only because an address is configured, which is what this scenario differs from FormingChapterCta - No Contact Address on.
